description: A shell script serving as a test runner for a project. It handles patch application idempotently, ensures specific revisions of dependencies are checked out, builds the project using CMake, and runs tests via CTest.

methods.name: apply_patch_idempotent
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a target directory idempotently, checking if the patch applies cleanly or is already applied.

methods.name: ensure_thundertools_expected_revision
methods.description: Checks out ThunderTools at a specified revision, ensuring a clean and matching baseline.

methods.name: run_build_and_l1_tests
methods.description: Configures, builds, and runs L1 tests for the project using CMake and CTest.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for executing the test workflow: patching, building, and testing.
